value.rationale: Complete source-resolved multivariate avalanche classification on a natural graph of triangles sharing one edge. Quantifies a rare macroscopic binomial burst of probability \(\asymp n^{-1}\) with mean topplings fixed at one and variance diverging linearly, a substantive difference from independent-branch friendship sandpiles and path-perimeter fans. This coefficientwise all-size law is useful for testing non-power-law stationary avalanche mechanisms and is not a routine renaming or numerical fragment.
